<link rel="stylesheet" href="html/landing_page_styles.css">

<style>

  position: absolute;
  top: 56px;
  right: 16px;
  z-index: 20;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,123,255,0.35);
  border-radius: 20px;
  color: rgba(0,100,210,0.75);
  font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
}
#random-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(0,123,255,0.12);
  border-color: rgba(0,123,255,0.65);
  color: rgba(0,100,210,1);
}
</style>

<div class="gradient_bg">
    <canvas id="hero-canvas"></canvas>
    <button id="random-btn" title="Generate random data">⟳ Random data</button>
    <div class="hero section_padding">
        <div class="hero_content">
          <div class="hero_title">Hi, I'm <span class="gradient_text">Lasai</span>.</div>
            <p>I'm a medical statistician dedicated to developing, validating, and improving clinical prediction models to aid medical decision-making focusing on honest and transparent development and evaluation of these models.
            </p>
            <p>
            I'm an FWO Postdoctoral fellow at KU Leuven in the Development and Regeneration department and within the International Ovarian Tumour Analysis (<a href="https://iotaplus.org/en/research/methodological-research" target="_blank"><span style='text-decoration: underline;text-decoration-color: #007BFF;'>IOTA</span></a>) group, working with  <a href="https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1613-7450" target="_blank"><span style='text-decoration: underline;text-decoration-color: #007BFF;'>Ben Van Calster</span></a>, <a href="https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3037-122X" target="_blank"><span style='text-decoration: underline;text-decoration-color: #007BFF;'>Laure Wynants</span></a>, and <a href="https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3707-6645" target="_blank"><span style='text-decoration: underline;text-decoration-color: #007BFF;'>Dirk Timmerman</span></a>. My work combines methodological and applied research to improve the calibration and clinical utility of prediction models, with a focus on models for ovarian cancer diagnosis, including the <a href="https://www.bmj.com/content/349/bmj.g5920" target="_blank"><span style='text-decoration: underline;text-decoration-color: #007BFF;'>ADNEX</span></a> model.
            </p>
            <p>If you'd like to collaborate or have questions about my work, feel free to reach out: <a href="mailto:lasai.barrenadataleb[at]kuleuven.be"><span style='text-decoration: underline;text-decoration-color: #007BFF;'>lasai.barrenadataleb@kuleuven.be</span></a></p>


        </div>
        <div class="hero_image">
            <img src="/img/lasai_headshot.png"/>
        </div>
        <div id="dot_container">
        </div>
    </div>

<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('hero-canvas');
  const ctx    = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const bg     = document.querySelector('.gradient_bg');

  const COLOR = '0, 100, 210';   // site-blue RGB
  const N     = 60;              // number of particles
  const DIST  = 150;             // max connection distance
  const MAX_DOTS = 10;           // regression drawn at this count

  let W, H, particles, raf;
  let clickDots = [];            // user-placed points
  let loessCurve = null;         // array of {x, y} for the fitted curve
  let rSquared   = null;         // R² value
  let hintOpacity = 0.65;        // hint text fade

  function init() {
    W = canvas.width  = bg.offsetWidth;
    H = canvas.height = bg.offsetHeight;

    particles = Array.from({ length: N }, () => ({
      x:  Math.random() * W,
      y:  Math.random() * H,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45,
      r:  Math.random() * 2 + 1.5
    }));
  }

  /* ── LOESS (locally weighted regression) ────────────────────── */
  function tricube(d) {
    return d < 1 ? Math.pow(1 - Math.pow(d, 3), 3) : 0;
  }

  function loessPredict(pts, xEval, span) {
    span = span || 0.75;
    const xs = pts.map(p => p.x);
    const ys = pts.map(p => p.y);
    const n  = xs.length;
    const k  = Math.max(Math.floor(n * span), 2);

    return xEval.map(x0 => {
      // Distances from x0 to each data point
      const dists = xs.map(xi => Math.abs(xi - x0));
      // k-th smallest distance defines the bandwidth
      const sorted = [...dists].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const h = sorted[k - 1] || 1e-10;

      // Tricube weights
      const w = dists.map(d => tricube(d / (h * 1.001)));

      // Weighted linear regression: y = a + b*x
      let sw = 0, swx = 0, swy = 0, swxx = 0, swxy = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        sw   += w[i];
        swx  += w[i] * xs[i];
        swy  += w[i] * ys[i];
        swxx += w[i] * xs[i] * xs[i];
        swxy += w[i] * xs[i] * ys[i];
      }
      const det = sw * swxx - swx * swx;
      if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-12) return { x: x0, y: swy / (sw || 1) };
      const a = (swxx * swy - swx * swxy) / det;
      const b = (sw * swxy - swx * swy) / det;
      return { x: x0, y: a + b * x0 };
    });
  }

  function computeLoess(pts) {
    if (pts.length < 3) return;
    const xMin = Math.min(...pts.map(p => p.x));
    const xMax = Math.max(...pts.map(p => p.x));
    if (xMax - xMin < 1) return;

    // Evaluate the curve at many points for a smooth line
    const nEval = 80;
    const step  = (xMax - xMin) / nEval;
    const xEval = Array.from({ length: nEval + 1 }, (_, i) => xMin + i * step);
    loessCurve = loessPredict(pts, xEval, 0.75);

    // R²: evaluate at data x-values
    const fitted = loessPredict(pts, pts.map(p => p.x), 0.75);
    const my = pts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.y, 0) / pts.length;
    let ssTot = 0, ssRes = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
      ssTot += (pts[i].y - my) * (pts[i].y - my);
      ssRes += (pts[i].y - fitted[i].y) * (pts[i].y - fitted[i].y);
    }
    rSquared = ssTot > 0 ? 1 - ssRes / ssTot : null;
  }

  /* ── Click handler ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  bg.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    // Don't intercept clicks on links or buttons
    if (e.target.closest('a, button, iframe')) return;

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    const y = (e.clientY - rect.top)  * (H / rect.height);

    // 11th click → reset, start fresh
    if (clickDots.length >= MAX_DOTS) {
      clickDots = [];
      loessCurve = null;
      rSquared = null;
    }

    hintOpacity = 0;  // hide hint on first click
    clickDots.push({ x, y, born: Date.now() });

    // Compute LOESS at exactly 10 points
    if (clickDots.length === MAX_DOTS) {
      computeLoess(clickDots);
    }
  });

  /* ── Animation loop ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function frame() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Move & bounce particles
    particles.forEach(p => {
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      if (p.x < 0 || p.x > W) p.vx *= -1;
      if (p.y < 0 || p.y > H) p.vy *= -1;
    });

    // Connecting lines
    for (let i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < N; j++) {
        const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
        const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
        const d  = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (d < DIST) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
          ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${COLOR}, ${(1 - d / DIST) * 0.18})`;
          ctx.lineWidth   = 1;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }

    // Background particles
    particles.forEach(p => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${COLOR}, 0.28)`;
      ctx.fill();
    });

    // ── User-placed dots ──────────────────────────────────────
    const now = Date.now();
    clickDots.forEach(d => {
      const age = Math.min((now - d.born) / 250, 1); // 250ms pop-in
      const r = 6 * age;
      // White border
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, r + 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
      ctx.fill();
      // Blue fill
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 100, 210, 0.85)';
      ctx.fill();
    });

    // ── LOESS curve ────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (loessCurve && loessCurve.length > 1) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(loessCurve[0].x, loessCurve[0].y);
      for (let i = 1; i < loessCurve.length; i++) {
        ctx.lineTo(loessCurve[i].x, loessCurve[i].y);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 100, 210, 0.6)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // ── R² display ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (rSquared !== null) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.font = '600 14px Inter, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 100, 210, 0.7)';
      ctx.fillText('R\u00B2 = ' + rSquared.toFixed(3), W - 18, 28);
      ctx.font = '400 13px Inter, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 70, 160, 0.5)';
      ctx.fillText('This is basically my job :)', W - 18, 48);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // ── Hint / counter ──────────────────────────────────────────
    if (hintOpacity > 0.01) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.font = '400 13px Inter, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 123, 255, ${hintOpacity})`;
      ctx.fillText('Click anywhere to place data points', W - 18, 24);
      ctx.restore();
      hintOpacity *= 0.998; // very slow fade even without clicking
    } else if (clickDots.length > 0 && clickDots.length < MAX_DOTS) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.font = '400 13px Inter, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 70, 160, 0.4)';
      ctx.fillText(clickDots.length + ' / ' + MAX_DOTS, W - 18, 24);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  /* ── Random data button ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('random-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clickDots = [];
    loessCurve = null;
    rSquared = null;
    hintOpacity = 0;

    const margin = 0.12; // keep dots away from edges
    const now = Date.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_DOTS; i++) {
      clickDots.push({
        x: W * (margin + Math.random() * (1 - 2 * margin)),
        y: H * (margin + Math.random() * (1 - 2 * margin)),
        born: now - 250  // skip the pop-in animation
      });
    }
    computeLoess(clickDots);
  });

  // Pause when tab is hidden to save resources
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    else frame();
  });

  init();
  frame();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    init();
    // Rescale click dots to new dimensions
    // (cleared on resize to avoid confusion)
    clickDots = [];
    loessCurve = null;
    rSquared = null;
    hintOpacity = 0.65;
  });
})();
</script>
